description: Most people emigrate with two checked bags. Everything else is sold, given away, or left in a relative's spare room indefinitely.

aspect: EXAMPLE - freight from Iran is not routine
description: International removals companies serving Iran are limited by sanctions exposure, and shipments route through the UAE or Turkey, adding handling, delay and loss risk.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the export caps apply to the shipment too
description: The 24 square metres of carpet, 150g of saffron and 150g of gold jewellery limits are not just hand-luggage rules - they cap what leaves at all (see FIN-005).

aspect: EXAMPLE - professional tools do not travel
description: Engineers' instruments, medical equipment, studio gear and anything dual-use-adjacent can attract export scrutiny on the way out and import scrutiny on the way in.
Personal libraries, family photographs and documents are the highest-value, lowest-weight cargo and the most commonly abandoned, because they are heavy and cannot be replaced.
energy_note: The things worth most are the things left behind.
